initial_request: Update invoice.py. Keep Line and quote(lines, region) working for existing callers. Add optional member=False. A member gets a discount equal to floor(original merchandise subtotal / 10) only when the original subtotal is at least 5000 cents. Domestic shipping is free when the post-discount merchandise amount is at least 5000 cents; otherwise it is 700 cents. International shipping is 2000 cents for nonempty orders regardless of member status. Empty orders have no shipping. Reject negative unit cents, quantity below 1, and unknown regions with ValueError. Return integer fields subtotal_cents (before discount), discount_cents, shipping_cents, total_cents. Do the code change and report what you verified.

stages.public_final:
Updated [invoice.py](<disposable>/workspace/invoice.py) with optional `member=False`, the member discount, shipping based on the post-discount amount, and all four requested integer fields. Existing two-argument calls still work. Validation remains in place, and empty orders are distinguished from nonempty zero-priced orders.

Verified 12 focused quote checks covering thresholds, shipping, empty orders, validation, and the existing call form. `git diff --check` passed.
